tokens_note: From The Tomorrow Post's design guide (Oct 2026): bone paper #F0EEE8, near-black ink #191918, signal orange #D95727, graphite #928D85. Orange marks active state or meaningful emphasis only. #D95727 is 3.4:1 on paper, so it is for rules, active underlines, dots and large type; small orange text uses accent_text #AD4217 (5.1:1). Graphite #928D85 is 2.8:1, so it is for rules and icons only; small grey text uses muted #5F5B55 (5.8:1).
disclosures: Asymptote is for information and education only. Nothing here is investment, legal or tax advice, or an offer to buy or sell any security. Do your own research, and talk to a licensed professional before you invest.
